claim_boundary: No superiority, generalisation, component-causal, bar, admission, held-out, confirmatory or paper-scale claim of any kind. A byte-identity count measures the instrument, not an effect; 50 of 50 would not make a 200-row floor, and fewer would not make a defect.
decision_140: Owner decision 140 (2026-09-26): the np1 cache-off test is authorised as a CHEAP TEST, but ADOPTION of any geometry is decided on THROUGHPUT, because future rounds need massive sampling. This cell decides a DETERMINISM question and INFORMS a THROUGHPUT one; the coordinator will not adopt np1 for sampling-heavy work on determinism alone. The read therefore reports, beside per-row byte identity, contacts per minute and prompt tokens per second for each pass at the np1 cache-off geometry -- from the sealed dispatch window (flight-receipts.json run_phases: wall_seconds, contact_window, contact_count) and the sealed generation manifest's cost block (prompt_tokens_total) -- and the same two numbers for the resident np4 geometry from ROLL-2's sealed arm (8,996 contacts, 81,435,827 prompt tokens, 16:00:01Z to 18:22:39Z, 8,558 s: 63.07 contacts per minute, 9,515.8 prompt tokens per second), so the trade is one table.
decision_rule_fixed_here: DESCRIPTIVE; there is no verdict and no admission. The deliverable is a COUNT: the number of the 50 rows whose delivered answer (the sealed outputs row's text, whose response_text_sha256 the read re-derives) is byte-identical between pass A and pass B, reported beside the same statistic ROLL-AA produced at np4 within one flight (183 of 200, 91.5 %) and the cross-flight np4 disagreement the instrument note records (about 28 % of raw outputs); the pair's pooled SLU-F1 and intent paired deltas with a CI95 by row bootstrap (10,000 draws, seed 20260915) as descriptive numbers; the intent-flip and entity-set-flip shares where the sealed per-sample scores carry the parsed prediction; and (decision 140) contacts per minute and prompt tokens per second per pass beside ROLL-2's np4 numbers, in one table. ROUTING: 50 of 50 identical -> the coordinator scales to 200 rows for the floor re-estimate (a separate registration); fewer -> the offset is intrinsic and the axis closes. A 50-row cell cannot support a floor re-estimate.
development_numbers_only: TRAIN Fold A construction rows (owner decisions 28 and 86); never a test claim.
failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. AT MOST ONE root-diagnosed recovery re-registration per pass; a second failure closes the pass and the fix is proven on a four-row dry run. A resident-session identity refusal spends no contact and is not a flight failure. A pass that seals alone answers nothing: the read needs both.
one_factor: The serving geometry, and nothing else: one 24,576-token slot (np1 c24576) with the prompt cache OFF (--no-cache-prompt) and no --slot-prompt-similarity, against the resident np4 c98304 prompt-cache-on geometry. In the composed config it is the model fragment's server_args / profile_slot_count / geometry_basis plus the baseline's serving_slots 4 -> 1; every other non-bookkeeping key is the locked PLAN cell's own bytes.
prohibitions: No effectiveness, superiority, generalisation, admission or floor-re-estimate claim from this cell: 50 rows decide only whether the 200-row re-estimate is worth flying.
No adoption of the np1 geometry for sampling-heavy work on determinism alone (decision 140): adoption is decided on throughput.
No test-split, Fold B or DEV contact or read.
No change to any knob of the locked plan; the geometry is the one variable and it is already fixed here.
